name: WMG dissertation figure palette
notes: Single source of truth for every dissertation figure. exhibits/mermaid-config.json and
exhibits/mermaid.css are generated from this file by scripts/build_figure_theme.py and must
The palette is one blue hue family (four tints plus one deep shade), one warm amber accent for
held/blocked/failed states, and one neutral grey. Blue against amber remains separable under
deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia, and no meaning depends on red against green.
Every non-standard role adds a second, non-colour cue (dash pattern and stroke weight) so the
figures stay readable in greyscale print.

layout.flowchart_renderer_note: ELK keeps annotation nodes on both sides of a chain instead of letting the chain drift diagonally, which produces a narrower figure and therefore larger on-page text.
layout.diagram_padding_note: Kept generous so that a dashed border on an outermost node is never clipped by the SVG viewport.
layout.wrapping_note:
Deliberately generous. Line breaks are authored with
in each .mmd source so that node width is a typographic decision, not an accident of automatic wrapping.

canvas.meaning: Figure background and table value cells.

ink.meaning: All label text and the border of every evidence-bearing node.

edge.meaning: Connector lines, arrowheads and edge-label text.

navy.meaning: Deep shade. Framing and boundary statements, and table header rows. Carries white text.

steel.meaning: Medium tint. Decision points and gates that the prose emphasises.

mist.meaning: Light tint. Standard process, workflow or pipeline step.

paper.meaning: Lightest tint. Cluster backgrounds, inputs and candidate material that is not yet evidence.

accent_fill.meaning: Amber accent fill. Held, blocked, rejected, failed or unmeasured states.

accent_line.meaning: Amber accent border, always dashed, for held, blocked, rejected or failed states.

neutral_fill.meaning: Neutral grey fill. Out-of-scope material and side annotations.

neutral_line.meaning: Neutral grey border, always dashed, for out-of-scope material and side annotations.

quiet_line.meaning: Muted blue border for inputs, candidate material and table value cells.

fx-banner.meaning: Framing statement, evidence boundary or table header row.

fx-key.meaning: Emphasised gate, decision or verification point.

fx-input.meaning: Input or candidate material that is not yet evidence.

fx-live.meaning: Control built and tested, but never run against a live external source.

fx-hold.meaning: Held, blocked, rejected, failed or explicitly unmeasured.
